description: Fork of exp144 (E=64, d_qk=32, qk_tph=384, V2D->SDPA, 392M, final 1.7101 — current E=64 SOTA). Replace V2D with simple element-wise STE sign on the qk_lut output: soft = x/(τ+|x|), hard = sign(x), STE forward = (hard - soft).detach() + soft. Like V2D but simpler — direct ±1 binarization without pair-difference structure. d_qk: 32 -> 992 (= 496*2; matches/doubles V2D's 496-dim ±1 output). qk_lut now produces 2*d_qk = 1984 outputs per head; switch to sparse scatter (qk_n_sparse_outputs=32, scatter to 1984) to keep weights manageable. Per-output votes = H*tph*n_sparse/(2*d_qk) = 6*384*32/1984 ≈ 37, matching exp144's 31 votes/output (each V2D component aggregates d_qk-1=31 sign comparisons). attn_scale_init = 1/sqrt(992) ≈ 0.0317 (principled for ±1 with ~independent components; learnable). Per-layer qk LUT weights: 37.75M -> 18.87M (-18.88M); 6 layers: -113M. Estimated total: ~279M (vs 392M).
